title: Protecting The School Garden
question: 把今天“裸露土壤 -> 大雨风险 -> 撒草籽 -> 扎根 -> 绿色出现”的恢复线，放进学校花园场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: Heavy rain is coming to the school garden. The bare soil may be washed away. We should spread grass seed over the ground. The grass will take root quickly. A few days later, patches of green have begun to appear.

options.label: A
options.scenario_zh: 先说学校花园马上会有大雨

options.label: B
options.scenario_zh: 说明裸露的土壤可能被冲走

options.label: C
options.scenario_zh: 提出行动：把草籽撒到地面上

options.label: E
options.scenario_zh: 用 patches of green 说绿色开始出现
options.english_template: A few days later, ___ have begun to appear.
